reasons: Both answers reject the Amazon persona and cover all six flow problems with Nielsen mappings and concrete mobile fixes, so the critiques are close to equal. The deciding difference is rubric item 2: A ends up handing over a single '+10%' figure for the slide. It is labeled as a conservative planning assumption, but it comes from assumed industry inputs and was then cut arbitrarily from its own ~20% estimate. B gives no number and instead shows how to build one from the store's own step-2 drop-off data, with a validation plan and realistic test durations.
